description: RNA-seq on mouse NIH-3T3, a spontaneously immortalized fibroblast cell line established from NIH Swiss mouse embryo fibroblasts using the 3T3 serial-transfer protocol; non-cancer fibroblast model used for proliferation, transformation, and stromal gene expression studies.
biosample_summary: Mus musculus NIH-3T3 embryonic fibroblast cell line
